item.title: Kashmir in Deep Freeze Again as Temperatures Slide; Pulwama Coldest at -5.5°C
item.description: Kashmir , Dec 12 : Kashmir Valley tightened under another harsh cold spell on Thursday as minimum temperatures fell sharply across the region. Pulwama recorded the lowest temperature at -5.5°C, while Shopian followed at -5.0°C. Srinagar dropped to -3.6°C, with the airport area dipping further to -4.0°C.
